people.name: Goshen
people.line: A region in Egypt where the Israelites settled and prospered.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
translations.bsb: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When Jacob’s family arrived in the land of Goshen,
translations.kjv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
translations.asv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to show the way before him unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
